scope: Searchable reference catalog. Documented and source-defined templates are examination candidates. Observed metadata refers only to exact present paths in the existing example JSON. No application payloads or artifact parsers were lab-validated for this catalog.

artifacts.environment: Native Windows current-user default; resolve effective application root
artifacts.storage_format: Directory; JSON records expected by documentation, contents unparsed locally
artifacts.source_version_or_checked_date: checked 2026-11-05; installed example file version recorded separately
supports: Existence of the checked directory and a candidate JSON record
does_not_establish: Conversation contents, submission, model use, or operator identity
collection_bundle: Conversation directory and existing neighboring records

artifacts.environment: Native Windows; model destination is configurable
artifacts.storage_format: Directory; model files and publisher/model hierarchy
supports: Files with .gguf extensions observed within the recorded traversal limits
does_not_establish: Model loading, inference, generated outputs, or intent

artifacts.environment: Native Windows home; other execution environments use their own home
artifacts.storage_format: Bounded text input history
supports: Retained CLI input candidates when acquired and parsed
does_not_establish: Complete responses, a timestamped execution audit, or API-only activity
collection_bundle: History file and any existing temporary counterpart

artifacts.environment: Native Windows desktop; source-defined, version-dependent candidate
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite; inspect captured schema
supports: Candidate desktop messages, tool records, or state after validated parsing
does_not_establish: Presence on the example host, CLI/API transcript coverage, or completed effects

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default; resolve HF_HOME, HF_HUB_CACHE, and XDG_CACHE_HOME
artifacts.storage_format: Repository directories, refs, blobs, and snapshots; symlink behavior varies
supports: Cached repository/model availability and revision context
does_not_establish: Inference, output creation, or a complete response history
collection_bundle: Resolved cache settings and link relationships

artifacts.environment: Source/portable default; directory flags and save nodes can change destinations
artifacts.storage_format: Generated files; format depends on save node
supports: Candidate saved outputs and relationships to recovered workflows
does_not_establish: Local generation, successful workflow execution, or authorship
collection_bundle: Referenced input/model identities and execution records

artifacts.environment: Node-, version-, format-, and settings-dependent
artifacts.storage_format: Optional PNG text metadata containing JSON workflow/prompt fields
supports: Recovered workflow parameters and node/input relationships
does_not_establish: An authenticated creation history or local execution
collection_bundle: Raw metadata export and parser version
Referenced workflow assets and corroborating records

artifacts.environment: Repository/data-root default; outdir settings and extensions can redirect
artifacts.storage_format: Generated image files and optional metadata
supports: Candidate output files within the effective save configuration
does_not_establish: Complete generation history or the machine/person that created a file

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and project-name overrides apply
artifacts.storage_format: JSONL; version-specific record types
supports: Recorded requests, responses, and tool relationships after validated parsing
does_not_establish: Complete retention, successful external effects, or operator identity
collection_bundle: Session JSONL and nested subagent records
Relevant attachments, tool outputs, and checkpoints

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default; effective configuration root and retention vary
artifacts.storage_format: File snapshots associated with session checkpoints
supports: Candidate pre-edit file state for tracked edits
does_not_establish: A complete shell/external-editor history or final accepted state
collection_bundle: Snapshot tree and associated session records

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default; autoMemoryDirectory/root overrides apply
artifacts.storage_format: Markdown index and topic files
supports: Retained context and references useful for identifying other evidence
does_not_establish: An execution audit or the truth of a remembered statement

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default; GEMINI_CLI_HOME changes the home root before .gemini is appended
artifacts.storage_format: Application session files; inspect captured version and structure
supports: Recorded project conversation and tool activity
does_not_establish: Complete retention, checkpoint availability, or completed effects
collection_bundle: Existing tmp checkpoints and shadow-history repository

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default; COPILOT_HOME changes the state root
artifacts.storage_format: JSONL plus session workspace artifacts
supports: Recorded CLI session events and references to workspace material
does_not_establish: Presence on the example host, complete service-side history, or successful tool effects

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default; COPILOT_HOME override applies
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite; subset/index of session information
supports: Cross-session lookup and checkpoint/search context
does_not_establish: Equivalence to full session files or presence on the example host

artifacts.environment: Native Windows current-user checked path
artifacts.storage_format: JSON expected by documentation; contents unparsed locally
artifacts.source_version_or_checked_date: documentation checked 2026-11-05; local metadata snapshot collector 1.1.0
supports: Presence of the checked known-name file
does_not_establish: Contents, authentication, successful sessions, or the installed schema generation

artifacts.environment: Native Windows documented default; XDG data root, OPENCODE_DB, and channel variants apply
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite; schema varies by generation
supports: Candidate project/session/message records after schema validation
does_not_establish: Compatibility with legacy JSON layouts or completed effects

artifacts.environment: Project-local default; history options/environment can redirect
artifacts.storage_format: Markdown history
supports: Retained project conversation context
does_not_establish: Unmodified original provenance, execution, or final workspace state
collection_bundle: Chat and input histories plus optional LLM history

artifacts.environment: Standard Windows user-data root; profiles, portable mode, and remote hosts differ

artifacts.environment: Standard Windows user-data root; verify active host/profile

artifacts.environment: Standard Windows candidate; resolve effective editor data root
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite; undocumented and evolving application encodings
supports: Candidate conversation/editor state after version-aware parsing
does_not_establish: Universal table queries, complete histories, or local execution

artifacts.environment: Historical standard VS Code candidate; current host/migration can differ
artifacts.storage_format: Conversation/UI/context JSON files; version-specific names and semantics
supports: Candidate task-level API/UI records when the host uses this root
does_not_establish: A universal current Cline location or equivalence of UI/API records
collection_bundle: Host storage context and Cline version

artifacts.environment: Source-defined home layout; CLINE root/data/database overrides apply
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite; inspect acquired schema and host implementation
supports: Candidate SDK/home-based session state
does_not_establish: Use by every Cline release/surface or presence on the example host
collection_bundle: Host version and effective path resolver context

artifacts.environment: Native Windows checked VS Code path; configured custom storage can differ
artifacts.storage_format: Directory; task JSON and index payloads unparsed locally
supports: Existence and direct-count metadata at the checked task root
does_not_establish: Parsed task contents, active/current tasks, or who initiated work

artifacts.environment: Native Windows default candidate; CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR can redirect
artifacts.storage_format: Individual session JSON and separate sessions.json list
supports: Candidate session documents and their list/index relationships
does_not_establish: Completeness from the session list alone or resulting code execution

artifacts.environment: Gateway host; native Windows default state usually beneath %USERPROFILE%\.openclaw
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite in the reviewed current documentation; legacy archive files differ

artifacts.environment: Native Windows checked default; HERMES_HOME and profiles can relocate state
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite expected by documentation; schema/contents unparsed locally
artifacts.observation_reference: examples/expanded-workstation-metadata.json: files, exact path match and sidecar rows
supports: Presence of the checked database filename and WAL/SHM companions
does_not_establish: Database contents, selected profile, or the relation to roaming UI state

artifacts.environment: Documented native Windows candidate; verify installation/configuration
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite; older JSONL records can remain after migration
supports: Candidate saved conversations and interactions across CLI/desktop
does_not_establish: Completeness from legacy JSONL alone or successful tool outcomes
collection_bundle: Relevant legacy records and operational logs

artifacts.environment: Runtime-root default; root and db_dir overrides apply
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite application database
supports: Candidate gallery/application records when coherently acquired and parsed
does_not_establish: Generated versus imported origin from storage presence alone

artifacts.environment: Configured output root; local-date folder naming
artifacts.storage_format: HTML history referencing image files and parameters
supports: Candidate parameter/file associations recorded by the application
does_not_establish: Authenticated provenance, complete temporary outputs, or UTC event time from folder name
collection_bundle: Raw image metadata and clock context

artifacts.environment: Configured service data directory
artifacts.storage_format: LiteDB; the .ldb suffix does not mean Chromium LevelDB
supports: Candidate account/session/preset state using the correct database parser
does_not_establish: Windows logon identity, generation, or backend execution host
collection_bundle: Effective output mapping and backend-host records

artifacts.environment: Configured training workspace; output/cache roots can differ
artifacts.storage_format: Serialized JSON run configuration
supports: Intended input, cache, workspace, and export relationships
does_not_establish: Training completion, final export, or who operated the run
collection_bundle: Referenced datasets and output identities within scope

artifacts.environment: Exact native Windows profile path checked in supplemental example; other profiles differ
artifacts.storage_format: SQLite expected by application documentation; contents unparsed locally
supports: Existence and size of the checked known-name browser artifact
does_not_establish: Visited AI services, successful downloads, or conversation content
collection_bundle: Profile/version context and relevant download records

artifacts.environment: Exact native Windows profile path checked in supplemental example
artifacts.storage_format: LevelDB directory candidate; contents unparsed locally

artifacts.environment: Exact current-user directory checked by the inventory

artifacts.environment: Windows configuration/version-dependent; protected-path access may be restricted
artifacts.storage_format: Binary Prefetch format; parser/version dependent

artifacts.environment: Windows version-dependent system artifact
